asset_manifests.name: Expedition DSLR Camera
asset_manifests.visual_identity: Professional-grade DSLR with a rugged, matte black weather-sealed body; features a large 24-70mm zoom lens with a glass-like lens flare; a vibrant orange 'DinoGames' branded neck strap; clear digital rear display showing a thumbnail of a fossil discovery.
asset_manifests.notes: Used by the team for site documentation. The body should have subtle dust textures on the rubber grips to match the field-worn aesthetic of the rock saw. Set against a light-grey neutral background for UI clarity.
